 099:     """
 100:     SMC FOC Controller Wrapper for NANOTEC DB42S02.
 101: 
 102:     Implements pure Sliding Mode Control (SMC) with integral sliding surface:
 103:         - Speed SMC: s = e + λ·∫e + γ·∫∫e
 104:         - Current SMC: equivalent control + switching with boundary layer
 105: 
 106:     Parameters
 107:     ----------
 108:     v_dc : float
 109:         DC bus voltage [V] (default: 17.0)
 110:     p_poles : int
 111:         Number of pole pairs (default: 4)
 112:     R_s : float
 113:         Stator resistance [Ω] (default: 0.19)
 114:     L_d : float
 115:         d-axis inductance [H] (default: 0.000125)
 116:     L_q : float
 117:         q-axis inductance [H] (default: 0.000125)
 118:     lambda_pm : float
 119:         Permanent magnet flux linkage [Wb] (default: 0.0014)
 120:     J_rotor : float
 121:         Rotor inertia [kg·m²] (default: 2.4e-6)
 122:     B_friction : float
 123:         Friction coefficient [N·m·s/rad] (default: 1e-6)
 124:     i_max : float
 125:         Maximum current [A] (default: 3.57)
 126:     dt_s : float
 127:         Sampling time [s] (default: 50e-6)
 128: 
 129:     Attributes
 130:     ----------
 131:     v_alpha, v_beta : float
 132:         Alpha/beta voltage references [V]
 133:     speed_est : float
 134:         Estimated mechanical speed [rad/s]
 135:     iq_ref : float
 136:         q-axis current reference [A]
 137:     status : int
 138:         Last operation status code (0 = success)
 139: 
 140:     Examples
 141:     --------
 142:     >>> controller = SMCControllerWrapper()
